issuing_body: 한국지능정보사회진흥원 (National Information Society Agency, NIA) / 과학기술정보통신부 (Ministry of Science and ICT)
compliance_deadlines: 고영향 인공지능 확인 요청 시 30일 이내 회신 (연장 시 최대 60일)
implementation_notes: The guideline implements Article 35 of the AI Basic Act (인공지능 발전과 신뢰 기반 조성 등에 관한 기본법). The impact assessment is framed as a best-effort obligation ('노력하여야 한다') for AI business operators providing high-impact AI products/services, not a strict legal mandate. Public institutions must preferentially consider products/services that have undergone impact assessment. Voluntary self-assessment is encouraged for all AI products. Interoperability with EU FRIA (AI Act Art. 27) and UNESCO Ethical Impact Assessment frameworks is an explicit design goal. Detailed procedures are to be specified by Presidential Decree.
